title: Split an output stream into lines
responsibility: Decode UTF-8 chunks and deliver complete lines while bounding the buffered text.

inputs.name: streamLines.options
inputs.type: { onLine: (line: string) => void; maxBytes: number; onOverflow: () => void; }
inputs.description: Line and overflow callbacks plus maximum buffered byte count.

outputs.name: streamLines
outputs.description: write accepts byte chunks and emits newline-delimited strings; end flushes any remaining text. Oversized buffered text invokes the overflow callback and clears the buffer.
